stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Why is the report all error?

stations.title: Night report
stations.text: Stops on the first line Python cannot read.

stations.title: Next shift
stations.text: Reads how the week went, line by line.

captions: Monday at the base. Rhona opens the night report and gets a block of error text.
Today Python stops at the first broken line, and the next shift reads nothing.
You read each error from the bottom up and fix the line it names.
Now the whole report prints, from the callouts to the crew on call.
Four errors, read and fixed. Next time Dougie can read one too.
